decisions.proposed_text: Trên trời dưới đất, duy ngã độc tôn,\nBạo quân tự xưng là Vua Turf
decisions.reason: Current first line is an unnecessarily stiff Sino-Vietnamese calque and the second uses the forbidden surface label sân cỏ. The revision preserves the boast while applying the established player-facing surface term.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.surface.turf requires 草地 → Turf and forbids Sân cỏ.

decisions.proposed_text: Gentildonna cương nghị.\nChỉ biết mạnh mẽ nở rộ!
decisions.reason: 贵妇人 is the character alias here, not the common noun quý phu nhân. The revision restores the canonical character identity and keeps the forceful blooming image.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded character.gentildonna locks 贵妇人 to Gentildonna.

decisions.proposed_text: Không bao giờ khuất phục.\nDù thua bao nhiêu lần, trái tim này cũng không tan vỡ!
decisions.reason: Bách chiết bất khuất is an unnatural Sino-Vietnamese calque in ordinary Vietnamese prose; the revision preserves the resilient meaning and emotional second line.

decisions.proposed_text: Cao quý, uy nghi\n——Đóa hoa xanh bạc kiêu hãnh nở đơn độc
decisions.reason: Lẫm liệt and bạc xanh are stiff/literal in this poetic description. The revision keeps the noble, solitary silver-blue-flower image in more natural Vietnamese and restores the source dash structure.
Meaning, warning tone, two-line structure, and natural Vietnamese are preserved without canonical or structural conflicts.
